entities.name: Enone carbonyl reduction
observations: Observed structural change is C=O to C–O while adjacent C=C and heteroaromatic framework remain unchanged; consistent with carbonyl 1,2-reduction.
ORD matches did not confirm a reducing reagent; candidate assignment is mechanistic plausibility, not database-verified.

entities.name: Sodium borohydride
observations: Plausible mild hydride reagent for selective ketone reduction while retaining an alkene; often used in alcohol solvents.

entities.name: Cerium(III) chloride
observations: With sodium borohydride (Luche conditions), can favor 1,2-reduction of an enone carbonyl over conjugate reduction.

entities.name: DIBAL-H
observations: Possible hydride alternative for carbonyl reduction under controlled low-temperature conditions; substrate-specific compatibility is uncertain.
